description:
A rest matched by a bitstring region is kept in a side table: DispatchState.rests (src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs) and DispatchExecState.rests (src/ir_interp/dispatch_exec.rs). The two disagree: native keeps a rest pending when a later question asks it, the interpreter builds it whole as soon as any question asks it.

Change: a matched rest is Transport { shape: Cursor, lanes: [source, position] } in the state's ordinary values, on both paths. dispatch_bit_source and bitstring_region_hit already read a cursor from values; a question that needs the bytes builds them through materialize_transport_value / materialize_cursor. Asking for the whole value does not overwrite the cursor in the slot. A rest stays a cursor when a later question asks it, on both paths.

Removed, fully: DispatchState.rests with its insert, its read in dispatch_bit_source and its remove in bind_dispatch_subject; DispatchExecState.rests, set_rest, rest, the undo clear, the lazy growth, the rest block in resolve_subject, and the eager build of an asked rest in read_bitstring; the doc text on both structs.

To measure, not assume: whether any plan asks one subject whole twice in one dispatch in the interpreter (native remembers per block in whole_cursors); where the interpreter's dispatch gets the Cursor ShapeId for a rest handed to nobody.

Predictions: fixture outputs unchanged on three paths; interp no longer builds a rest that is matched and then asked by a later bit question (probe: "a" <> rest then another match); case-walk probe unchanged; pins same.

Done when: grep finds no rests table on either path; gate green.

Proposal page: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.cursor-fold.html (approved by the user 2026-11-15: remove special cases; what is no longer needed is fully removed).
title: Dispatch state holds a matched rest as a cursor value
